description:
ACT Consulting is a U.S. owned and operated staffing company providing our clients with candidates on a national basis for contract, contract to hire, and direct hire engagements. Title: Senior Director of Sales Operations (X95V45XR)
Locations: Long Beach, CA
Duration: Fulltime
Rate – $ 195000.00 USD - 250000.00 USD

Manager Notes:
CANDIDATES MUST HAVE THESE QUALIFICATIONS - ﻿Experience with CRM, Salesforce strongly preferred, ﻿experience selling into industries such as Government, Insurance, Education, Financial Services, highly analytical individual with experience using Power BI or Tableau, and ﻿experience with Sales Operations Frameworks.
Hybrid: Three days per week (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday) in-office in Long Beach, CA

Summary
Our client, a leading enterprise SaaS platform, is seeking a Director or Senior Director of Sales Operations to lead, oversee, and optimize the U.S.-based direct sales organization. This senior-level role will be responsible for driving sales strategy, process improvement, forecasting, and analytics to accelerate revenue growth and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate is a strategic leader with deep experience in SaaS sales operations, passionate about scaling teams, refining processes, and partnering cross-functionally to achieve company-wide revenue and margin goals.

Key Responsibilities
Sales Strategy & Planning
  • Lead and manage the U.S. direct sales operations, including goal setting, forecasting, and performance management.
  • Develop and execute scalable SaaS sales strategies to increase revenue and sales efficiency.
  • Partner with executive leadership to set and monitor revenue goals and pipeline objectives.
  • Deliver actionable insights through KPI analysis, dashboards, and performance reporting.
  • Mentor and develop sales leaders and teams to foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Operations & Process Optimization
  • Design, streamline, and optimize sales processes, systems, and workflows to improve productivity and scalability.
  • Implement and manage sales enablement tools, including Salesforce, ensuring data integrity and consistency.
  • Build standardized reporting and analytics frameworks using SaaS best practices for sales adoption and visibility.
  • Drive operational excellence by establishing data-driven methodologies and clear performance metrics.
Revenue & Performance Management
  • Support revenue planning and target-setting across sales teams while monitoring performance and forecasting accuracy.
  • Track and optimize win rates, deal cycles, and churn to improve efficiency and conversion.
  • Recommend enhancements to sales structures, deal processes, and resource allocation.
  • Provide leadership with ongoing reporting, trend analysis, and business insights to guide strategic decisions.
Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Ensure strong alignment between Sales, Finance, Marketing, and Professional Services to enhance customer onboarding and retention.
  • Collaborate with Finance and the VP of Sales on sales incentive design, planning, and performance measurement.
  • Partner with cross-functional leaders to align sales strategies with corporate objectives and long-term customer success goals.

Qualifications
  • Bachelors degree or equivalent experience required; advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in sales operations and/or sales leadership within a SaaS organization.
  • Proven success leading direct and channel partner sales teams with measurable revenue growth.
  • Deep knowledge of SaaS sales processes, forecasting, pipeline analysis, and enablement.
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen with the ability to model and communicate complex data.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce and analytics tools (e.g., Power BI).
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and executive presentation skills.

This is a high-impact role for a data-driven, strategic sales operations leader ready to help scale a growing SaaS business and optimize sales performance across the enterprise.

Job Title: Cyber Security Engineering Manager
Job Location: Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania
Type: Permanent Role, Onsite Role
Salary: Commensurate with the best in the industry

Overview
Our client, a global materials technology company, is seeking a Cyber Security Engineering Manager to lead the design, deployment, and support of enterprise-wide cybersecurity solutions. This role oversees a talented technical team responsible for implementing and maintaining security platforms, managing vulnerabilities, and delivering data-driven risk insights that strengthen the company's global security posture.

Reporting directly to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), the manager will play a key role in aligning engineering, operations, and strategy across corporate and manufacturing environments.

Key Responsibilities
Lead the Security Engineering & Support team, including personnel management, budgeting, and delivery of secure, scalable enterprise solutions.
Oversee the deployment, lifecycle management, and support of global security technologies across IT, end-user, and cybersecurity domains.
Own and execute the organization's vulnerability management strategy, ensuring visibility into threats and proactive reduction of the attack surface.
Develop and maintain cybersecurity risk and compliance dashboards, providing actionable insights through KPIs and KRIs.
Manage operational security functions such as privileged access, compliance support, and technology governance in alignment with regulatory requirements.
Partner with IT, business units, and manufacturing technology teams (PLCs, HMIs, SCADA) to ensure secure integration and operational resilience across enterprise and plant-level systems.

Qualifications

Required:
  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.
  • 7+ years of experience in enterprise IT, infrastructure, or cybersecurity.
  • 2+ years of management experience leading IT or cybersecurity professionals.
  • U.S. citizenship or legal authorization to access controlled technology under ITAR and EAR regulations.
  • Strong interpersonal, leadership, and communication skills.

Preferred:
  • Proven success in leading vulnerability management programs and implementing best practices.
  • Experience managing departmental budgets and resource planning.
  • Exposure to manufacturing or operational technology (OT) security environments.
  • Active security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or Security+.
  • Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or Engineering.

Why This Role
This is an outstanding opportunity to lead a high-impact cybersecurity function within a global, innovation-driven manufacturing environment. The successful candidate will shape enterprise security strategy, enhance system resilience, and directly contribute to protecting mission-critical technologies across operations worldwide.

Job Title: Senior Business Systems Analyst - hybrid (1)
Job Location: Irvine, CA
Full time Direct
Salary Range: 115000.00 USD - 144000.00 USD

About the Role
Our client, a leader in the food service and distribution industry, is seeking a Senior Business Systems Analyst to join their corporate IT team. This role is responsible for delivering high-quality systems design, business requirements, and process improvements that drive efficiency, scalability, and business productivity across the organization.

The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with business leaders and IT partners to analyze, design, and implement system solutions that support critical operational functions, including finance, procurement, sales, and warehouse management. Experience with JD Edwards ERP and JDA/Blue Yonder WMS is strongly preferred.

Key Responsibilities
Business Requirements & Analysis

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements through collaboration with stakeholders and subject matter experts.
Evaluate current business systems and workflows to identify areas for improvement.
Develop detailed business cases, process documentation, and system enhancement proposals.
Translate business needs into detailed project briefs and system specifications.
Support costing and sizing for enhancement requests in coordination with the IT organization.
Solution Design & Implementation

Identify and evaluate technical and business solutions to meet defined requirements.
Create logical, innovative, and practical solutions for complex system challenges.
Collaborate with architects, developers, and business users to ensure solutions align with functional needs and IT standards.
Develop feasibility reports and design proposals for leadership review and approval.
Testing & Quality Assurance

Develop and execute test plans, use cases, and user acceptance testing for new or modified systems.
Validate that changes are implemented accurately, documented properly, and minimize business disruption.
Evaluate new features or system upgrades before release and provide feedback to development teams.
Training & User Support

Develop user training materials, manuals, and support resources.
Conduct training sessions to ensure smooth adoption of new systems and features.
Serve as a key point of contact for ongoing system support and process optimization.
Leadership & Knowledge Sharing

Mentor and support junior team members on processes, tools, and methodologies.
Coordinate cross-team efforts and assist in prioritizing workloads.
Promote best practices across IT functions and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
Qualifications
Associate degree or equivalent technical training required; Bachelor's degree preferred.
8+ years of systems design, business analysis, and testing experience, including leadership or mentoring responsibilities.
Strong understanding of distribution industry processes: Sales-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Accounting (AP/AR), and Warehouse Management.
Hands-on experience with JD Edwards ERP and JDA/Blue Yonder WMS or similar platforms.
Ability to translate complex business needs into technical requirements and functional designs.
Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Technical Competencies
Expert: Application Configuration Management, Automated Testing Tools, ITIL Incident Management
Proficient: Application Integration, Data Transport, Packaged Software, Information Security, SOA Strategy, UI Design
Basic: Client/Server Systems, High Availability, Business Continuity, Infrastructure Technology
This is an excellent opportunity for a driven Business Systems Analyst who enjoys working at the intersection of technology, operations, and business process improvement and wants to make an immediate impact within a leading food service organization.

PLEASE MAKE SURE ALL CANDIDATES HAVE THESE QUALIFICATIONS
﻿8+ years of systems design and test experience with some related leadership experience. ﻿
Experience working in core distribution business processes such as Sales to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounting (AP/AR), and Warehouse Management. ﻿
Ability to understand, communicate, and interpret client business processes and requirements. ﻿
Ability to configure and test with the users. ﻿
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Job Title: ​​ Embedded Firmware Engineer (ACTRO0610)
Location: ​​ Hawthorne, CA
Duration: ​​ Fulltime
​Pay Rate- $100,000 – $175,000


Role Summary
As the first Embedded Firmware Engineer at client, you'll design, write, and deploy the core embedded flight software that will control the company's debut constellation of satellites. Your work will enable communications, autonomous behavior, and in-orbit upgrades for mission-critical systems, with the opportunity to scale your architecture across future vehicles.

Core Responsibilities
  • Architect and implement flight software (OS, mission logic, C&DH, comms) for spacecraft
  • Ensure software is fault-tolerant, modular, and remotely updatable
  • Work closely with avionics engineers on electrical and processor architecture
  • Build software for critical hardware (e.g., star trackers, ADCS, sail deployment, batteries, cameras)
  • Design and test embedded systems with unit tests, simulation, and HIL setups
  • Own version control, release, and validation standards

Must-Have Qualifications
  • Embedded C/C++ experience on electromechanical platforms (e.g., drones, spacecraft, robotics)
  • Proven work on high-reliability, fault-tolerant, remotely-operable systems
  • Track record designing or architecting complex embedded systems
  • Ability to work independently and make rapid decisions in a fast-paced environment
  • Exceptional, outlier-level personal or professional achievement, e.g.: Built something ambitious solo (custom hardware, startup, etc.)
  • Youngest tech lead at a major company Olympic athlete, viral creator, Everest climber, etc.
  • Promoted quickly without traditional credentials

Preferred Qualifications
  • BS in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Electrical, Aerospace, or Industrial Engineering
  • Experience learning from real-world electromechanical system deployment
  • Prior experience at companies like SpaceX, Blue Origin, NASA, Northrop Grumman, Tesla, or F1 teams
